editorial.title: Engineering Manager, Identity Platform
editorial.overviewZh: 负责 OpenAI 身份平台的基础服务与工程团队，重点是大规模身份认证、访问安全、低延迟和高可用性。以下内容由 HHBA 根据企业公开招聘页面独立整理，不是官方原文。
responsibilitiesZh: 组建、指导和发展身份平台工程团队，支持工程师与技术负责人的长期成长。
规划核心身份系统的技术方向、产品需求协作、阶段目标与交付。
负责大规模分布式身份基础设施的架构质量，重点保障可靠性、隐私、安全和响应速度。
管理登录认证与令牌交换相关的基础设施和运行质量。
改善登录用户在边缘节点的请求校验，支持高并发和高可靠性。
推进用户数据受控访问能力，协调基础设施、产品及安全团队。
requirementsZh: 企业公开要求：具备十年以上大规模分布式系统建设、扩展或运行经验。
企业公开要求：具备三年以上高绩效工程团队管理经验。
具备工程团队培养、人员招聘、跨团队沟通和技术决策能力。
熟悉高规模后端系统的可靠性、延迟、安全治理和生产运维。
拥有涵盖计算、集群、服务及存储的基础设施经验。
benefitsZh: 官网当次公开的旧金山基本年薪区间为 293,000—385,000 美元，另有股权；实际待遇和招聘状态请以官网最新信息为准。
editorial.overviewEn: HHBA editorial summary based on OpenAI's published vacancy: leads foundational identity services and the engineering team responsible for reliable, secure access.
responsibilitiesEn: Build, coach and lead the identity engineering team.
Own the roadmap, architecture and delivery of core identity infrastructure.
Guide secure, reliable and low-latency large-scale distributed systems.
Oversee the authentication and token-exchange systems.
Improve high-throughput request validation and secure user-data access.
requirementsEn: The published role asks for 10+ years building and operating large-scale distributed systems.
It also asks for 3+ years leading high-performing engineering teams.
Experience in production backend reliability, infrastructure and security is relevant.
Leadership, hiring, mentoring and cross-functional collaboration are important.
benefitsEn: Base pay listed at review: USD $293,000–$385,000 plus equity; verify the latest details with the employer.
